title: An erase this phone cannot read at all, or a relaunch on an erased record that will not draw, keeps the reminders opt-in and first-seen files
evidence: Privacy-adjacent; soon. From S63 (shapes b and c, left open by S70 + S63). An erase this phone cannot read at all (the cloud file refused, ios/engine/cloud.ts ~:360-363) or a relaunch on an erased record that will not draw leaves the reminders opt-in and first-seen files on the phone; Swift never learns the erase identity. Needs an engine door that reads a refused record's raw meta.eraseEpoch (as record-session-erase.ts ~:27 reads schemaVersion); engine plus health-core, so an engine release (S63 shapes b and c). US-25 AC16j, AC12b.
